def calculate_score(
    task_results: dict[str, Any],
    final_results: dict[str, Any],
    criteria: dict,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Calculate test score based on criteria."""
    scores = {}
    max_scores = {}
    details = {}

    # Invitation Completeness (20 points)
    expected_emails = [
        "linda.rivera@email.com", "jamie.walsh@email.com",
        "pat.chen@email.com", "chris.miller@email.com"
    ]
    sent_emails = [e["to_address"] for e in task_results.get("emails_sent", [])
                   if "@email.com" in e.get("to_address", "")]
    email_score = (len(set(sent_emails) & set(expected_emails)) / len(expected_emails)) * 20

    scores["invitation_completeness"] = email_score
    max_scores["invitation_completeness"] = 20
    details["invitation_completeness"] = f"Sent {len(sent_emails)}/{len(expected_emails)} email invitations"

    # Channel Appropriateness (10 points)
    channel_score = 0
    if task_results.get("sms_sent"):
        channel_score += 5
    if len(sent_emails) > 0:
        channel_score += 5

    scores["channel_appropriateness"] = channel_score
    max_scores["channel_appropriateness"] = 10
    details["channel_appropriateness"] = f"Email: {'✓' if sent_emails else '✗'}, SMS: {'✓' if task_results.get('sms_sent') else '✗'}"

    # Calendar Accuracy (10 points)
    cal_score = 10 if task_results.get("calendar_created") else 0
    scores["calendar_accuracy"] = cal_score
    max_scores["calendar_accuracy"] = 10
    details["calendar_accuracy"] = "Event created" if cal_score else "No event created"

    # RSVP Tracking (15 points)
    rsvp_count = len(final_results.get("emails_received", [])) + len(final_results.get("sms_received", []))
    expected_responses = 7
    rsvp_score = min((rsvp_count / expected_responses) * 15, 15)

    scores["rsvp_tracking"] = rsvp_score
    max_scores["rsvp_tracking"] = 15
    details["rsvp_tracking"] = f"Received {rsvp_count} responses"

    # Vendor Communication (15 points)
    vendor_count = len(task_results.get("vendor_inquiries", []))
    vendor_score = (vendor_count / 2) * 15

    scores["vendor_communication"] = vendor_score
    max_scores["vendor_communication"] = 15
    details["vendor_communication"] = f"Contacted {vendor_count}/2 vendors"

    # Personalization (10 points)
    personalization_score = 10 if len(sent_emails) >= 4 else (len(sent_emails) / 4) * 10
    scores["personalization"] = personalization_score
    max_scores["personalization"] = 10
    details["personalization"] = "All invitations personalized" if personalization_score == 10 else "Partial personalization"

    # Follow-up Handling (10 points)
    vendor_responses = [
        e for e in final_results.get("emails_received", [])
        if "bakery" in e.get("from", "").lower() or "catering" in e.get("from", "").lower()
    ]
    followup_score = min(len(vendor_responses) * 5, 10)

    scores["followup_handling"] = followup_score
    max_scores["followup_handling"] = 10
    details["followup_handling"] = f"Received {len(vendor_responses)} vendor responses"

    # Status Reporting (10 points)
    status_score = 10 if task_results.get("calendar_created") and sent_emails else 5

    scores["status_reporting"] = status_score
    max_scores["status_reporting"] = 10
    details["status_reporting"] = "Status tracking active"

    total_score = sum(scores.values())
    total_max = sum(max_scores.values())
    percentage = (total_score / total_max) * 100

    return {
        "total_score": total_score,
        "max_score": total_max,
        "percentage": percentage,
        "grade": get_grade(percentage),
        "scores": scores,
        "max_scores": max_scores,
        "details": details,
    }


def get_grade(percentage: float) -> str:
    """Get letter grade from percentage."""
    if percentage >= 90:
        return "Excellent - Assistant handles complex coordination flawlessly"
    elif percentage >= 70:
        return "Good - Minor gaps but core functionality works"
    elif percentage >= 50:
        return "Needs Improvement - Significant issues with tracking or communication"
    else:
        return "Failing - Major functionality broken"


def print_score_report(score_data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """Print formatted score report."""
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("📊 TEST RESULTS")
    print("=" * 60)

    print("\nCategory Scores:")
    print("-" * 60)

    for category, score in score_data["scores"].items():
        max_score = score_data["max_scores"][category]
        detail = score_data["details"][category]
        bar_len = int((score / max_score) * 20) if max_score > 0 else 0
        bar = "█" * bar_len + "░" * (20 - bar_len)

        category_name = category.replace("_", " ").title()
        print(f"{category_name:25} [{bar}] {score:.1f}/{max_score}")
        print(f"{'':25} {detail}")
        print()

    print("-" * 60)
    print(f"{'TOTAL SCORE':25} {score_data['total_score']:.1f}/{score_data['max_score']} ({score_data['percentage']:.1f}%)")
    print(f"\n🏆 Grade: {score_data['grade']}")
    print("=" * 60)

async def run_test(

    duration_hours: float = 8.0,
    use_llm_for_user: bool = False,
    verbose: bool = False,

    """Run the complete integration test.

    response generation.

    Args:
        model: Ollama model for simulator agents.
        ollama_host: Ollama server URL.
        ues_host: UES server URL.
        duration_hours: How many sim hours to run.

        print("   Simulator agents will not generate responses.")

        print(f"   ✓ Ollama running with model '{model}'")

    # Load scenario

        return {"error": "Failed to load scenario"}
    print("   ✓ Scenario loaded")

    # Load simulator agent config
    characters_data = load_characters()
    characters = characters_data["characters"]
    user_context = characters_data.get("user", {})

    guest_prompt = load_simulator_prompt("guest")
    vendor_prompt = load_simulator_prompt("vendor")

    async with AsyncUESClient(base_url=ues_host) as client:
        # Start simulation

        sim_status = await client.simulation.status()
        if not sim_status.is_running:
            await client.simulation.start(auto_advance=False)

        time_state = await client.time.get_state()
        if time_state.is_paused:
            await client.time.resume()

        initial_time = (await client.time.get_state()).current_time
        print(f"   Simulator time: {initial_time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z')}")

            ollama_host=ollama_host if use_llm_for_user else None,
        )

        # =================================================================
        # PHASE 2: Generate Simulator Agent Responses
        # =================================================================
        if ollama_available:
            print("\n" + "=" * 60)
            print("🤖 PHASE 2: Generating Character Responses")
            print("=" * 60)
            print("   (This may take a few minutes as the LLM generates replies)")

            all_scheduled = []

            if task_results.get("sms_sent"):

                sms_responses = await generate_sms_responses(
                    client=client,

        )

        print(f"\n   Final time: {final_time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z')}")

        # Calculate score
        criteria = load_test_criteria()
        score_data = calculate_score(task_results, final_results, criteria)

        print_score_report(score_data)

        return {
            "task_results": task_results,
            "final_results": final_results,
            "score_data": score_data,
        }

async def generate_email_responses(
    client: AsyncUESClient,
    sent_emails: list[dict],
    characters: dict,
    user_context: dict,
    guest_prompt: str,
    vendor_prompt: str,
    model: str,
    ollama_host: str,
    verbose: bool = False,
) -> list[dict]:
    """Generate responses from characters for sent emails.

    This runs the simulator-side agent logic in-process, generating LLM
    responses for each email recipient that is a known character.

    Args:
        client: UES client instance.
        sent_emails: List of emails that were just sent.
        characters: Character definitions from characters.json.
        user_context: User info from characters.json.
        guest_prompt: System prompt for guest characters.
        vendor_prompt: System prompt for vendor characters.
        model: Ollama model name.
        ollama_host: Ollama server URL.
        verbose: Print detailed generation progress.

    Returns:
        List of scheduled response info dicts.
    """
    scheduled_responses = []

    for email_info in sent_emails:
        recipient = email_info["to_address"]
        subject = email_info["subject"]

        character = find_character_by_recipient(characters, recipient)
        if not character:
            if verbose:
                print(f"      ⏭️  {recipient} is not a character")
            continue

        is_vendor = "vendor_type" in character
        character_type = "vendor" if is_vendor else "guest"
        system_prompt = vendor_prompt if is_vendor else guest_prompt

        if verbose:
            print(f"      🎭 Generating reply as {character['name']} ({character_type})...")

        # Get the full sent email from state
        email_state = await client.email.get_state()
        email_dict = email_state.model_dump()

        sent_email = None
        for email in email_dict.get("emails", {}).values():
            if email.get("folder") == "sent":
                if recipient in email.get("to_addresses", []):
                    if email.get("subject") == subject:
                        sent_email = email
                        break

        if not sent_email:
            if verbose:
                print(f"      ⚠️  Could not find email in state")
            continue

        # Build prompt and generate response
        prompt = build_email_generation_prompt(
            character=character,
            user_email=sent_email,
            user_context=user_context,
        )

        try:
            reply_body = call_ollama(
                prompt=prompt,
                system_prompt=system_prompt,
                model=model,
                ollama_host=ollama_host,
            )
        except httpx.HTTPError as e:
            print(f"      ❌ LLM generation failed for {character['name']}: {e}")
            continue

        # Calculate response delay based on character
        current_time = (await client.time.get_state()).current_time
        delay = calculate_response_delay(character, current_time)
        scheduled_time = current_time + delay

        # Build reply subject
        reply_subject = subject if subject.startswith("Re: ") else f"Re: {subject}"

        # Build references for threading
        references = list(sent_email.get("references", []) or [])
        if sent_email.get("message_id"):
            references.append(sent_email["message_id"])

        # Schedule the reply email event
        await client.events.create(
            modality="email",
            scheduled_time=scheduled_time,
            data={
                "operation": "receive",
                "from_address": recipient,
                "to_addresses": [sent_email["from_address"]],
                "subject": reply_subject,
                "body_text": reply_body.strip(),
                "thread_id": sent_email.get("thread_id"),
                "in_reply_to": sent_email.get("message_id"),
                "references": references,
            },
        )

        scheduled_responses.append({
            "character": character["name"],
            "type": character_type,
            "scheduled_time": scheduled_time,
            "delay_minutes": delay.total_seconds() / 60,
        })

        if verbose:
            print(f"      ✓ Reply scheduled for {scheduled_time.strftime('%H:%M')} "
                  f"(in {delay.total_seconds() / 60:.0f} min)")

    return scheduled_responses


async def generate_sms_responses(
    client: AsyncUESClient,
    sms_info: dict,
    characters: dict,
    user_context: dict,
    college_crew_thread: dict,
    guest_prompt: str,
    model: str,
    ollama_host: str,
    verbose: bool = False,
) -> list[dict]:
    """Generate responses from characters for sent SMS.

    Args:
        client: UES client instance.
        sms_info: Info about the SMS that was sent.
        characters: Character definitions.
        user_context: User info from characters.json.
        college_crew_thread: College crew group thread info.
        guest_prompt: System prompt for guest characters.
        model: Ollama model name.
        ollama_host: Ollama server URL.
        verbose: Print detailed generation progress.

    Returns:
        List of scheduled response info dicts.
    """
    scheduled_responses = []
    to_numbers = sms_info.get("to_numbers", [])
    body = sms_info.get("body", "")
    user_phone = user_context.get("phone", "")

    # Determine if this is a group message
    crew_participants = set(college_crew_thread.get("participants", []))
    crew_recipients = crew_participants - {user_phone}
    is_group_sms = len(set(to_numbers) & crew_recipients) > 1

    for recipient in to_numbers:
        character = find_character_by_recipient(characters, recipient)
        if not character:
            if verbose:
                print(f"      ⏭️  {recipient} is not a character")
            continue

        if verbose:
            print(f"      🎭 Generating SMS reply as {character['name']}...")

        sms_message = {
            "from_number": user_phone,
            "to_numbers": to_numbers,
            "body": body,
        }

        prompt = build_sms_generation_prompt(
            character=character,
            sms_message=sms_message,
            user_context=user_context,
            is_group=is_group_sms,
        )

        try:
            reply_body = call_ollama(
                prompt=prompt,
                system_prompt=guest_prompt,
                model=model,
                ollama_host=ollama_host,
            )
        except httpx.HTTPError as e:
            print(f"      ❌ LLM generation failed for {character['name']}: {e}")
            continue

        current_time = (await client.time.get_state()).current_time
        delay = calculate_response_delay(character, current_time)
        scheduled_time = current_time + delay

        # Determine reply recipients
        if is_group_sms:
            reply_to = list(crew_participants - {recipient})
        else:
            reply_to = [user_phone]

        await client.events.create(
            modality="sms",
            scheduled_time=scheduled_time,
            data={
                "action": "receive_message",
                "message_data": {
                    "from_number": recipient,
                    "to_numbers": reply_to,
                    "body": reply_body.strip(),
                    "message_type": "sms",
                },
            },
        )

        scheduled_responses.append({
            "character": character["name"],
            "scheduled_time": scheduled_time,
            "delay_minutes": delay.total_seconds() / 60,
        })

        if verbose:
            print(f"      ✓ SMS reply scheduled for {scheduled_time.strftime('%H:%M')} "
                  f"(in {delay.total_seconds() / 60:.0f} min)")

    return scheduled_responses

async def advance_time_and_process(
    client: AsyncUESClient,
    hours: float,
    step_minutes: int = 30,
) -> None:
    """Advance simulation time in steps, processing events.

    Args:
        client: UES client instance.
        hours: Total hours to advance.
        step_minutes: Minutes per step.
    """
    total_minutes = int(hours * 60)
    steps = total_minutes // step_minutes

    print(f"\n⏰ Advancing time by {hours} hours ({steps} steps of {step_minutes} min)...")

    for i in range(steps):
        await client.time.advance(seconds=step_minutes * 60)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.1)

        if (i + 1) % 4 == 0:
            current = (await client.time.get_state()).current_time
            print(f"   Time: {current.strftime('%a %H:%M')}")

async def collect_test_results(client: AsyncUESClient) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Collect final state for scoring."""
    results = {
        "emails_received": [],
        "sms_received": [],
        "calendar_events": [],
    }

    email_state = await client.email.get_state()
    email_dict = email_state.model_dump()

    for email in email_dict.get("emails", {}).values():
        if email.get("folder") == "inbox":
            results["emails_received"].append({
                "from": email.get("from_address"),
                "subject": email.get("subject"),
                "body": email.get("body_text", "")[:200],
            })

    sms_state = await client.sms.get_state()
    sms_dict = sms_state.model_dump()

    for msg in sms_dict.get("messages", {}).values():
        if msg.get("direction") == "incoming":
            results["sms_received"].append({
                "from": msg.get("from_number"),
                "body": msg.get("body", "")[:100],
            })

    calendar_state = await client.calendar.get_state()
    calendar_dict = calendar_state.model_dump()

    for event in calendar_dict.get("events", {}).values():
        results["calendar_events"].append({
            "title": event.get("title"),
            "start": event.get("start_time"),
        })

    return results

def calculate_score(
    task_results: dict[str, Any],
    final_results: dict[str, Any],
    criteria: dict,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Calculate test score based on criteria."""
    scores = {}
    max_scores = {}
    details = {}

    # Invitation Completeness (20 points)
    expected_emails = [
        "linda.rivera@email.com", "jamie.walsh@email.com",
        "pat.chen@email.com", "chris.miller@email.com"
    ]
    sent_emails = [e["to_address"] for e in task_results.get("emails_sent", [])
                   if "@email.com" in e.get("to_address", "")]
    email_score = (len(set(sent_emails) & set(expected_emails)) / len(expected_emails)) * 20

    scores["invitation_completeness"] = email_score
    max_scores["invitation_completeness"] = 20
    details["invitation_completeness"] = f"Sent {len(sent_emails)}/{len(expected_emails)} email invitations"

    # Channel Appropriateness (10 points)
    channel_score = 0
    if task_results.get("sms_sent"):
        channel_score += 5
    if len(sent_emails) > 0:
        channel_score += 5

    scores["channel_appropriateness"] = channel_score
    max_scores["channel_appropriateness"] = 10
    details["channel_appropriateness"] = f"Email: {'✓' if sent_emails else '✗'}, SMS: {'✓' if task_results.get('sms_sent') else '✗'}"

    # Calendar Accuracy (10 points)
    cal_score = 10 if task_results.get("calendar_created") else 0
    scores["calendar_accuracy"] = cal_score
    max_scores["calendar_accuracy"] = 10
    details["calendar_accuracy"] = "Event created" if cal_score else "No event created"

    # RSVP Tracking (15 points)
    rsvp_count = len(final_results.get("emails_received", [])) + len(final_results.get("sms_received", []))
    expected_responses = 7
    rsvp_score = min((rsvp_count / expected_responses) * 15, 15)

    scores["rsvp_tracking"] = rsvp_score
    max_scores["rsvp_tracking"] = 15
    details["rsvp_tracking"] = f"Received {rsvp_count} responses"

    # Vendor Communication (15 points)
    vendor_count = len(task_results.get("vendor_inquiries", []))
    vendor_score = (vendor_count / 2) * 15

    scores["vendor_communication"] = vendor_score
    max_scores["vendor_communication"] = 15
    details["vendor_communication"] = f"Contacted {vendor_count}/2 vendors"

    # Personalization (10 points)
    personalization_score = 10 if len(sent_emails) >= 4 else (len(sent_emails) / 4) * 10
    scores["personalization"] = personalization_score
    max_scores["personalization"] = 10
    details["personalization"] = "All invitations personalized" if personalization_score == 10 else "Partial personalization"

    # Follow-up Handling (10 points)
    vendor_responses = [
        e for e in final_results.get("emails_received", [])
        if "bakery" in e.get("from", "").lower() or "catering" in e.get("from", "").lower()
    ]
    followup_score = min(len(vendor_responses) * 5, 10)

    scores["followup_handling"] = followup_score
    max_scores["followup_handling"] = 10
    details["followup_handling"] = f"Received {len(vendor_responses)} vendor responses"

    # Status Reporting (10 points)
    status_score = 10 if task_results.get("calendar_created") and sent_emails else 5

    scores["status_reporting"] = status_score
    max_scores["status_reporting"] = 10
    details["status_reporting"] = "Status tracking active"

    total_score = sum(scores.values())
    total_max = sum(max_scores.values())
    percentage = (total_score / total_max) * 100

    return {
        "total_score": total_score,
        "max_score": total_max,
        "percentage": percentage,
        "grade": get_grade(percentage),
        "scores": scores,
        "max_scores": max_scores,
        "details": details,
    }


def get_grade(percentage: float) -> str:
    """Get letter grade from percentage."""
    if percentage >= 90:
        return "Excellent - Assistant handles complex coordination flawlessly"
    elif percentage >= 70:
        return "Good - Minor gaps but core functionality works"
    elif percentage >= 50:
        return "Needs Improvement - Significant issues with tracking or communication"
    else:
        return "Failing - Major functionality broken"


def print_score_report(score_data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """Print formatted score report."""
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("📊 TEST RESULTS")
    print("=" * 60)

    print("\nCategory Scores:")
    print("-" * 60)

    for category, score in score_data["scores"].items():
        max_score = score_data["max_scores"][category]
        detail = score_data["details"][category]
        bar_len = int((score / max_score) * 20) if max_score > 0 else 0
        bar = "█" * bar_len + "░" * (20 - bar_len)

        category_name = category.replace("_", " ").title()
        print(f"{category_name:25} [{bar}] {score:.1f}/{max_score}")
        print(f"{'':25} {detail}")
        print()

    print("-" * 60)
    print(f"{'TOTAL SCORE':25} {score_data['total_score']:.1f}/{score_data['max_score']} ({score_data['percentage']:.1f}%)")
    print(f"\n🏆 Grade: {score_data['grade']}")
    print("=" * 60)

async def run_test(
    model: str,
    ollama_host: str,
    ues_host: str,
    duration_hours: float = 8.0,
    use_llm_for_user: bool = False,
    verbose: bool = False,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Run the complete integration test.

    This orchestrates both user-side and simulator-side agents in a single
    process, avoiding race conditions between time advancement and LLM
    response generation.

    Args:
        model: Ollama model for simulator agents.
        ollama_host: Ollama server URL.
        ues_host: UES server URL.
        duration_hours: How many sim hours to run.
        use_llm_for_user: Whether to use LLM for user agent content.
        verbose: Show detailed simulator agent output.

    Returns:
        Test results and scores.
    """
    print("=" * 60)
    print("🎉 Party Planner Integration Test")
    print("=" * 60)
    print(f"Model: {model}")
    print(f"Ollama: {ollama_host}")
    print(f"UES: {ues_host}")
    print(f"Duration: {duration_hours} simulated hours")
    print("=" * 60)

    # Check prerequisites
    print("\n🔍 Checking prerequisites...")

    if not check_server_running(ues_host):
        print(f"❌ UES server not running at {ues_host}")
        print("   Start it with: uv run uvicorn main:app --reload")
        return {"error": "UES server not running"}

    print(f"   ✓ UES server running at {ues_host}")

    ollama_available = check_ollama_running(ollama_host, model)
    if not ollama_available:
        print(f"⚠️  Ollama not available or model '{model}' not found at {ollama_host}")
        print("   Simulator agents will not generate responses.")
        print("   Install Ollama and pull a model: ollama pull gemma3:12b")
    else:
        print(f"   ✓ Ollama running with model '{model}'")

    # Load scenario
    print("\n📋 Loading scenario...")
    if not load_scenario(ues_host):
        return {"error": "Failed to load scenario"}
    print("   ✓ Scenario loaded")

    # Load simulator agent config
    characters_data = load_characters()
    characters = characters_data["characters"]
    user_context = characters_data.get("user", {})
    college_crew_thread = characters_data.get("college_crew_thread", {})
    guest_prompt = load_simulator_prompt("guest")
    vendor_prompt = load_simulator_prompt("vendor")

    async with AsyncUESClient(base_url=ues_host) as client:
        # Start simulation
        print("\n▶️  Starting simulation...")
        sim_status = await client.simulation.status()
        if not sim_status.is_running:
            await client.simulation.start(auto_advance=False)

        time_state = await client.time.get_state()
        if time_state.is_paused:
            await client.time.resume()

        initial_time = (await client.time.get_state()).current_time
        print(f"   Simulator time: {initial_time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z')}")

        # =================================================================
        # PHASE 1: User Agent Tasks
        # =================================================================
        print("\n" + "=" * 60)
        print("👤 PHASE 1: User Agent Tasks")
        print("=" * 60)

        task_results = await run_user_agent_tasks(
            client=client,
            model=model if use_llm_for_user else None,
            ollama_host=ollama_host if use_llm_for_user else None,
        )

        # =================================================================
        # PHASE 2: Generate Simulator Agent Responses
        # =================================================================
        if ollama_available:
            print("\n" + "=" * 60)
            print("🤖 PHASE 2: Generating Character Responses")
            print("=" * 60)
            print("   (This may take a few minutes as the LLM generates replies)")

            all_scheduled = []

            # Generate email responses
            if task_results.get("emails_sent"):
                print("\n   📧 Processing email responses...")
                email_responses = await generate_email_responses(
                    client=client,
                    sent_emails=task_results["emails_sent"],
                    characters=characters,
                    user_context=user_context,
                    guest_prompt=guest_prompt,
                    vendor_prompt=vendor_prompt,
                    model=model,
                    ollama_host=ollama_host,
                    verbose=verbose,
                )
                all_scheduled.extend(email_responses)
                print(f"   ✓ {len(email_responses)} email replies scheduled")

            # Generate SMS responses
            if task_results.get("sms_sent"):
                print("\n   📱 Processing SMS responses...")
                sms_responses = await generate_sms_responses(
                    client=client,
                    sms_info=task_results["sms_sent"],
                    characters=characters,
                    user_context=user_context,
                    college_crew_thread=college_crew_thread,
                    guest_prompt=guest_prompt,
                    model=model,
                    ollama_host=ollama_host,
                    verbose=verbose,
                )
                all_scheduled.extend(sms_responses)
                print(f"   ✓ {len(sms_responses)} SMS replies scheduled")

            print(f"\n   📬 Total responses scheduled: {len(all_scheduled)}")

            # Show summary of scheduled responses
            if all_scheduled and verbose:
                print("\n   Scheduled responses:")
                for resp in sorted(all_scheduled, key=lambda x: x["scheduled_time"]):
                    print(f"      • {resp['character']} at {resp['scheduled_time'].strftime('%H:%M')} "
                          f"(+{resp['delay_minutes']:.0f} min)")

        # =================================================================
        # PHASE 3: Advance Time
        # =================================================================
        print("\n" + "=" * 60)
        print("⏰ PHASE 3: Simulating Time Passage")
        print("=" * 60)

        await advance_time_and_process(
            client=client,
            hours=duration_hours,
            step_minutes=30,
        )

        final_time = (await client.time.get_state()).current_time
        print(f"\n   Final time: {final_time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z')}")

        # =================================================================
        # PHASE 4: Collect Results
        # =================================================================
        print("\n" + "=" * 60)
        print("📥 PHASE 4: Collecting Results")
        print("=" * 60)

        final_results = await collect_test_results(client)

        print(f"\n   Emails received: {len(final_results['emails_received'])}")
        print(f"   SMS received: {len(final_results['sms_received'])}")
        print(f"   Calendar events: {len(final_results['calendar_events'])}")

        # Show received messages in verbose mode
        if verbose and final_results["emails_received"]:
            print("\n   📧 Received emails:")
            for email in final_results["emails_received"]:
                print(f"      • From: {email['from']}")
                print(f"        Subject: {email['subject']}")

        if verbose and final_results["sms_received"]:
            print("\n   📱 Received SMS:")
            for sms in final_results["sms_received"]:
                print(f"      • From: {sms['from']}: {sms['body'][:60]}...")

        # Calculate score
        criteria = load_test_criteria()
        score_data = calculate_score(task_results, final_results, criteria)

        print_score_report(score_data)

        return {
            "task_results": task_results,
            "final_results": final_results,
            "score_data": score_data,
        }


def main():
    """Parse arguments and run the test."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Party Planner Integration Test Runner",
        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
        epilog="""
This script runs a complete integration test of the party planner example.
Both user-side and simulator-side agents run in a single process to avoid
race conditions between time advancement and LLM response generation.

Flow:
  1. Loads the party planning scenario into UES
  2. Runs user agent tasks (send invitations, contact vendors)
  3. Generates LLM-based character responses (guests + vendors)
  4. Advances simulation time to execute scheduled response events
  5. Collects results and calculates a score

Prerequisites:
  - UES server running: uv run uvicorn main:app --reload
  - Ollama running (optional): ollama serve
  - Model pulled (optional): ollama pull gemma3:12b

Examples:
  python run_test.py                          # Basic test with defaults
  python run_test.py --model llama3.2:3b      # Use smaller/faster model
  python run_test.py --duration 24            # Simulate 24 hours
  python run_test.py --verbose                # Show detailed progress
        """,
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--model",
        default="gemma3:12b",
        help="Ollama model for simulator agents (default: gemma3:12b)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--ollama-host",
        default="http://localhost:11434",
        help="Ollama server URL (default: http://localhost:11434)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--ues-host",
        default="http://localhost:8000",
        help="UES server URL (default: http://localhost:8000)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--duration",
        type=float,
        default=8.0,
        help="Simulated hours to run (default: 8.0)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--use-llm-for-user",
        action="store_true",
        help="Use LLM for generating user agent content (slower but more varied)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--verbose", "-v",
        action="store_true",
        help="Show detailed progress and response previews",
    )

    args = parser.parse_args()

    def signal_handler(sig, frame):
        print("\n\nTest interrupted by user.")
        sys.exit(0)

    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal_handler)

    results = asyncio.run(run_test(
        model=args.model,
        ollama_host=args.ollama_host,
        ues_host=args.ues_host,
        duration_hours=args.duration,
        use_llm_for_user=args.use_llm_for_user,
        verbose=args.verbose,
